Affiliate Partnerships

System Internals reaches senior engineers, DevOps, and backend developers who make infrastructure purchasing decisions. If your product helps them build, debug, or scale systems — let's talk.

Why Partner With System Internals

  • Deep technical audience Readers are the engineers who actually evaluate and buy infrastructure tools — not managers.
  • High-intent traffic Our readers come looking for solutions to real problems. They're actively researching, not browsing casually.
  • Trusted content The blog has published detailed, technical deep dives on Linux, databases, networking, and distributed systems.

Who We're Looking For

We partner with products that fit the audience:

  • Cloud infrastructure & VPS — Cloud providers, serverless platforms, bare metal
  • Observability & monitoring — APM, tracing, logging, metrics, alerting
  • Developer tooling — CI/CD, container platforms, databases, caches
  • Networking & security — CDNs, DNS, DDoS protection, VPNs, certificate management
  • Performance profiling — Profiling tools, benchmarking, load testing
  • Managed services — Managed databases, queues, search, observability SaaS

Partnership Options

Affiliate Links

We embed referral links in relevant posts and resource pages. You get a commission on any referred customers — typically 10% recurring for 12 months. Clean, honest recommendations only.

Sponsored Content

A well-researched post about your product, written to our editorial standards. Not a press release — a genuine technical piece that helps readers.

Newsletter Feature

A mention or mini-review in our newsletter to our subscriber base. High open rates, direct delivery.

Interested?

If you have a product that genuinely helps systems engineers, reach out with a brief intro: who you are, what you offer, and why it's relevant to our audience.

You can find us through the contact info on the About page.
